summary: SMX (Security Matters) PLC filed a Form 6-K with a press release dated September 8, 2026, announcing the launch of its four-layer Digital Material Passport Platform (DMPP) for plastics. The platform integrates molecular marking, digital passports, material verification, trading infrastructure, and circularity credits. No transaction, tender, restructuring, or special-situation event is involved. The filing is routine product/business development disclosure by a foreign private issuer, with no deal terms, advisors, board actions, or capital markets activity. There is nothing to watch from a risk-arb or special-situations perspective.
